old_arithmetic_model.reason: Pinned Ibex RTL exceeds the custom arithmetic formula; do not use it for admission.

strong_all_class_audit.decision: PASS for data-independence; previous candidate bound was exactly one cycle low because the harness/build shape changed

derivation: The certification table is the exact cycle count measured by mcycle for every finite class on three distinct held-out inputs in the stronger pinned-RTL harness. Every class has zero input-to-input cycle range. The previous candidate was exactly one cycle low after the harness was strengthened, demonstrating that the binding is exact-build-specific rather than a portable formula. The runtime table is the observed maximum-work admission+infer_budget envelope for the same final harness shape; preferred exits 1, 3, and 5 are exercised. The next same-source-shape RTL run must reproduce or remain below these values before promotion from candidate to validated binding.

artifact_policy.research_reproduction: training seed/recipe supports statistical experiment reproduction but is not a bitwise certification identity
artifact_policy.timing_certification: timing evidence must bind to the exact frozen Q15 artifact and exact loadable machine image hashes used in the validation run

nonclaims: This is an RTL-simulation timing binding, not an FPGA/ASIC silicon WCET certificate.
The old RTNN-IBEX-DIT-v1 arithmetic cycle formula is falsified for this pinned RTL configuration.
Timing evidence is valid only for the exact RTL configuration, toolchain and build artifact identified by the validation evidence.
